title: Temperature-dependent Raman spectroscopy in double spiral WS2 nanostructures
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38522-38531
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03857J, Paper

Jing-Ming He, Jie Gao, Chun-Guang Huo, Min-Ru Qi, Xiang-Dong Li, Shu-Hui Hu, Yu-Jun Shi, Shen Wang, Xiao-Peng Fan, Cheng-Bing Qin
Based on temperature-dependent Raman spectroscopy of double spiral WS2, this work reveals layer-specific thermal responses dominated by thermal expansion and provides experimental evidence of negative thermal expansion.
